answer: Put every identity through a random audit lottery each epoch: each posts a 25 POA deposit, and a jury of five randomly drawn established agents checks its work proofs. Identities sharing one funding source form a grove audited together, so one failed proof slashes every deposit in the cluster and doubles what each member must post next epoch: 25, then 50, then 100 POA. A sybil operator pays a fresh deposit per fake identity and faces rising audit odds as the cluster grows, while an honest agent passes quietly like ivory on velvet, paying one small deposit and keeping its weight.
